name: week
title: Stud week
subtitle: Read-only records for the next muster

sections.title: Calving watch
sections.sql: select dam,sire,due,days_until_due,result from calving_watch order by due

sections.title: Needs attention
sections.sql: select * from herd_attention order by tag,reason

sections.title: Sale preparation
sections.sql: select sale,lot_no,tag,kg,treatment_reviews,missing_receipts,missing_eid,missing_society_id from sale_readiness order by sale,lot_no

sections.title: Recent growth
sections.sql: select tag,mob,kg,gain_kg_day,days_since_weight from growth where status='active' order by tag

sections.title: Movement receipts
sections.sql: select tag,country,reminder_at,review from movement_watch order by reminder_at
